protocol.title: Automated Microfluidic Platform for Dynamic and Combinatorial Drug Screening of Tumor Organoids
protocol.platform: Two-part PDMS microfluidic device: 200-well 3D culture chamber array + solenoid-valve multiplexer control device
cell_lines: PDAC Patient 1 (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, patient-derived organoids)
PDAC Patient 2 (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, patient-derived organoids)
PDAC Patient 3 (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, patient-derived organoids)
protocol.objective: High-throughput culture, combinatorial drug screening, and temporal/sequential drug delivery to patient-derived PDAC organoids in Matrigel; real-time apoptosis and cell death quantification; multi-patient parallel comparison

layers: Chamber layer: PDMS 200-well array, 610 um average well height, glass slide base
Channel layer: PDMS fluidic channels, 455 um height, reversibly clamped onto chamber layer

multiplexer.actuation: Automated via custom MATLAB GUI (tab-delimited text / CSV input)

microscope.model: Nikon Eclipse Ti (inverted, automated translational stage)
microscope.enclosure: Life Imaging Service GmbH environmental chamber

Caspase37_Reagent.analysis: MATLAB trapezoid integration of fluorescence intensity over 72 h

steps.name: Organoid culture establishment
steps.operation: dispense + mix (abstracted manual pipetting into 610-um wells)
steps.cell_prep: Mechanically dissociated to single cells via TrypLE Express (Fisher Scientific 12605-010) before loading
steps.notes: Each treatment arm receives its own independently dispensed culture in separate wells. Channel layer clamped and pressurised at 5 psi after loading.

steps.name: 14-day growth phase
steps.operation: heat (in-place incubation, void/no assignment in BioScript)
steps.imaging: Continuous time-lapse, 10x, every 2-4 h; automated MATLAB segmentation tracks cross-sectional area
steps.endpoint: Organoids mature to ~500 um diameter 3D glandular structures

steps.name: Single-agent drug screen (Patient 1, 72-h arm)
steps.replenishment: Fresh complete media + drug dispensed and mixed at 48-h mark
steps.fix_applied: FIX A: Split into phase1 (2880m) + replenishment + phase2 (1440m) to correctly place 48-h media exchange

steps.name: Temporal FOLFIRINOX (Patient 1)
steps.clinical_reference: Standard FOLFIRINOX IV regimen for PDAC
steps.fix_applied: FIX B: Final low-dose 5-FU extended to 4050m (not 2760m/46h from clinical text); paper states 'until the end of the 72-h experiment'. 120+120+30+4050=4320m.

steps.name: Temporal Gemcitabine + 5-FU (Patient 1)
steps.fix_applied: FIX C: Cycle 2 final 5-FU truncated from 2880m to 960m per Fig 4f visual truncation. 240+2880+240+960=4320m.

steps.name: Temporal Gemcitabine + Paclitaxel (Patient 1)
steps.clinical_significance: Most effective regimen for Patient 1 (Fig 4g); retrospectively matched to clinical outcome (Table 2)
steps.fix_applied: FIX C: Final media step padded from 1440m to 1920m per Table 1 schedule. 240+240+1440+240+240+1920=4320m.
steps.internal_inconsistency_note: Table 1 schedule (encoded here) differs from Fig 4g schedule. Fig 4g shows: Cycle1 2h Gem + 2h Pac + 44h Media; Cycle2 2h Gem + 4h Pac + 18h Media. Table 1 schedule selected as primary encoding per reviewer guidance.

steps.name: Multi-patient parallel Gem+5FU temporal (P1/P2/P3)
steps.note: Patient 1 Gem+5FU arm already encoded in Section 7. P2 and P3 encoded identically.
steps.qc_arm: Patient 2 (p=7E-07 vs control, Fig 5b; most sensitive to Gem+5FU temporal)
steps.fix_applied: FIX C: Same 960m truncation applied to p2Finished and p3Finished. 240+2880+240+960=4320m.

primary_gate.pass_action: dispose all P1 single-agent and temporal arm droplets (BB2)
primary_gate.fail_action: drain all P1 single-agent and temporal arm droplets (BB3)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Culture establishment, 14-day growth, all 9 drug treatment sections, both QC detects

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose apoptosisQC; fall through to multi-patient gate

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.content: dispose multiPatQC; experiment ends; device disassembled for organoid harvest

bioscript_compiler_notes.duration_units: s and m only (h token not supported)
bioscript_compiler_notes.no_loops: All multi-cycle regimens fully unrolled (Gem+5FU x2, Gem+Pac x2)
bioscript_compiler_notes.heat_void: All heat instructions are void/in-place; no LHS assignment
bioscript_compiler_notes.detect_single_use: Each detect result (apoptosisQC, multiPatQC) assigned exactly once
bioscript_compiler_notes.fluid_single_use: Each arm has independently dispensed cultures, markers, and drugs; no fluid variable used as mix/detect source more than once per linear chain
bioscript_compiler_notes.encoding_scope: Patient 1 full arm (7 single-agent + 5 temporal); Patient 2 and 3 encoded for Gem+5FU temporal parallel comparison only
bioscript_compiler_notes.ascii_only: File is strict ASCII; all Unicode symbols removed (checkmarks, arrows) to prevent ANTLR4 FileStream UnicodeDecodeError

fixes_applied.issue: 48-hour replenishment bug: original 4320m single mix meant replenishment occurred at 72h+10s not at 48h
fixes_applied.fix: Split each single-agent arm into phase1 (2880m) + dispense fresh media+drug + phase2 (1440m). Total = 4320m.

fixes_applied.issue: Duration deficit: FOLFIRINOX/FOLFIRI/FOLFOX total was 50.5h or less; platform would idle 21.5h before QC gate
fixes_applied.fix: Extended final low-dose 5-FU step to 4050m in all three regimens so total = 4320m per 'until end of 72-h experiment' paper text.

fixes_applied.issue: Gem+5FU overshot 72h (104h total); Gem+Pac fell short of 72h (64h total)
fixes_applied.fix: Gem+5FU cycle 2 final 5-FU truncated to 960m (240+2880+240+960=4320m); Gem+Pac final media padded to 1920m (240+240+1440+240+240+1920=4320m). Same 960m truncation applied to P2 and P3 arms in Section 9.

fixes_applied.issue: ANTLR4 FileStream opened in ASCII mode; UTF-8 checkmark (U+2713) and arrow (U+2190) in comments caused UnicodeDecodeError at position 14172
fixes_applied.fix: All non-ASCII characters replaced with ASCII equivalents (OK, <--); file re-encoded as strict ASCII.
